snippets: We have decided to continue to allow sellers to use their original prompts in combination with AI tools to create the artwork they sell on Etsy.
Sellers must disclose within their listing description if an item is created with the use of AI.
While we allow the use of AI tools in the creative process, we prohibit the sale of AI prompt bundles on our platform.
Any AI-generated depictions of nudity and sexual content must follow the rules and restrictions outlined by our Prohibited Items Policy.
We prohibit content which infringes on the privacy, publicity, and personal rights of others.
